intro: Burning Blood is an unnatural fluid harvested from the ferocious Nightbane worgen prowling Duskwood. The Stormwind armorer Grimand Elmore requires twenty vials of this fiery essence to experiment with advanced smithing techniques.

p: The cursed Nightbane worgen infesting Duskwood run hot with a strange, unnatural fury, and their blood burns with literal heat. This searing fluid can be drawn from the beasts haunting the haunted timberlands and the abandoned dig site of Roland's Doom. While grotesque to harvest, the fiery substance holds rare metallurgical properties coveted by master armorers seeking to quench and temper resilient plate.

Grimand Elmore, a veteran craftsman working in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, seeks to test novel smithing methods pioneered by his former student Furen Longbeard. To see if these radical forging techniques hold merit, Elmore requires burning blood alongside a dense burning rock held by the worgen chieftain Gutspill. Those willing to face the predatory pack and return with the bubbling fluid are promised sturdy warrior armor forged in the heat of his forge.
